claims: WrestleMania 42 will be held at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on April 18 and 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 marks a consecutive return to Las Vegas following the 2025 event.
The 2025 event was held in Las Vegas.
John Cena is set to host WrestleMania 42.
Two-day combo tickets for WrestleMania 42 are available via Ticketmaster.
Two-day combo tickets for WrestleMania 42 went on sale September 24, 2025.
Single-day tickets for WrestleMania 42 are available starting November 28, 2025.
Allegiant Stadium is known as the "Death Star".
Allegiant Stadium is in Las Vegas, NV.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled for Sunday, April 19, 2026.
The theme songs for WrestleMania 42 are "Back in the Saddle" (2025 remix) by Aerosmith/Yungblud and "Bones for the Crows" by Nickelback.
According to MGM Resorts, additional WWE events (SmackDown, Raw) are scheduled at local arenas surrounding WrestleMania 42.
Allegiant Stadium is located off the I-15.
Allegiant Stadium is close to the Las Vegas Strip.
Allegiant Stadium is accessible by Uber, Lyft, or shuttle services.
WWE chose to return to Las Vegas following a record-breaking 2025 event.
